name: Rubescent-Catafalque
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around crystal cavern networks, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
the automated beacon of unknown purpose was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
